prompt: STYLE, AND IT OVERRIDES ANY OTHER READING OF THE REFERENCE IMAGES: render this in warm editorial ink-and-wash. ONE image only, no panels.  Rendered in the style of the FIRST reference image, which is a STYLE ANCHOR ONLY and whose contents must never be drawn.
